rv.t: I had been here once before and thought I’d left a review, so this time I’ll make sure to. Both experiences were great and I enjoyed not only the food but the ambulance. All of the dishes were tasty, from the chicken to the dumplings to the kimchi pork. The prices are reasonable and the service fast. Cool spot to hangout and enjoy a good time.

I had a wonderful recommendation to checkout this place. Downstairs was a standing table, which was cool, but the seating upstairs, for me, was the way to go. The vibe and music were really good. Although Google only allows for solid stars, I would give this place a 4.2 /5 stars. The food was delicious. I had the octopus tempura which had a nice outer crunch and a soft inside. Second, I had the fish carpaccio, which…
First floor has standing area, you can get 200yen discount per glass of shot.

1897.a: TORAYA AN STAND Shinjuku, NEWoMan新宿 ２階 5 Chome-24-55 Sendagaya, Shibuya, Tokyo 151-0051, Japan
1897.aj: 〒151-0051 東京都渋谷区千駄ケ谷５丁目２４−５５ NEWoMan新宿 ２階 トラヤあんスタンド新宿店
1897.ed: Elegant, minimalist setting for iced lattes, plus a counter selling sweets made from red bean paste.
1897.edj: 冷たいカフェオレを提供する、エレガントでシンプルなカフェ。カウンターで小豆餡を使ったスイーツを販売。

rv.t: I love An Paste!! They specialize in desserts that that include red bean paste. If you love red bean, you’ll enjoy their menu. They’re located in the Takashimaya Mall, outside on the 2nd floor. Minimal seating, only small parties. I ordered the A Paste Cafe Au Lait - it was milky & delicious, however it was very sweet! So be aware of that. It comes with A Paste at the bottom that’s to be mixed with the rest of the…

Love the iced matcha and seasonal An Shiruko (Amazake) 🥰 The red bean paste on our toast was beautiful as well. Service is kind and organized with separate queues for dine in vs takeaway. There’s a limit of 60 mins if you’re dining in to be fair to other customers and you’re not encouraged to talk on the phone here which is Japanese courtesy to others.

Went with a friend in the evening. It wasn't crowded. The menu is limited and easy to navigate. The bean paste toast was tasty. I enjoyed the chestnut paste more than the read bean paste. The addition of butter really makes a difference. The matcha latte was good. It had read bean paste at the bottom. I also had the apple juice, which had a nice flavor and wasn't too sweet. Would recommend if you're in the area.

1898.aj: 〒317-0063 茨城県日立市若葉町１丁目１１−１ まちの拠点 BUILD.

1899.a: Japan, 〒311-0324 Ibaraki, Hitachiota, Shirawacho, 755-2 scone&coffee ｒ. アールドット
1899.aj: 〒311-0324 茨城県常陸太田市白羽町７５５−２ scone&coffee ｒ. アールドット

rv.t: ずっと行きたかった憧れのスコーン屋さん。 住まいからかなり遠いのとやってる日が少ないのでタイミングも難しく念願の来店。 オープン前からいっぱいでした！ 注文も一組一組 時間がかかるので 並んで15分ぐらい待ちました。 かぼちゃのプリン🍮抹茶ラテ、スコーンをイートイン 憧れのテラス席で。 お天気も良くてポカポカ気持ちよかったです。 離れにもお席があるし、外にもベンチがあり 里山が綺麗。 友人達にスコーンのお土産を買いました。 皆美味しいと喜んでくれてよかった！ 憧れのアールドットさんにやっと伺えて幸せな日でした。

イートインで出していただいたスコーンは温めてくださっており、チョコがほどよく溶けていてとても美味しかったです！バタースコーンも味わい深く美味しかったです！ お店の方は、丁寧な接客対応でした。 人気のお店のようです。混んでいました。女性客が多く訪れている印象です。週末だっため、駐車場も混んでいてとめる場所を見つけるのに苦労しました。 着いたときは、お店の入り口に列ができていました。混んでいるときは、イートインで注文しても出てくるまでにかなりの時間を要します。

常陸太田の結構山の方の住宅街にありました。駐車場は、お店の反対側にありました。古民家の一部がカフェになってます。脇にイートインスペースや、外、下の東屋でも食べれるそうです。広くて綺麗な芝生では、子供やワンコも遊んでいいそうです。 オーナーさんが、丁寧に説明してくれました。 営業日をインスタで確認して一応、DM送って行きました。返事を入れてくれてました。前に行ったときを２時頃だったから、スコーンは売り切れてたので今回は、１０時半前に着くように行きました。何人か並んでましたが、いろいろ買えました。

1900.a: Capian Coffee, 1949-11 Tsuda, Hitachinaka, Ibaraki 312-0032, Japan
1900.aj: 〒312-0032 茨城県ひたちなか市津田１９４９−１１ カピアンコーヒー
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1900.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious coffee, especially the cute latte art, and the hearty breakfast sets, including crispy toast and flavorful bagels. They also highlight the cozy atmosphere and the reasonable prices for both food and coffee beans. Some reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
1900.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいコーヒー、特に可愛らしいラテアート、そしてサクサクのトーストや風味豊かなベーグルを含むボリューム満点のモーニングセットが高く評価されています。また、居心地の良い雰囲気や、食事とコーヒー豆の両方において手頃な価格も特徴として挙げられています。 一部のクチコミでは、スタッフの対応にばらつきがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: This place is EXCELLENT. I have been there more than 10+ times to enjoy their coffee and food! The chef is absolutely fantastic and I cannot get enough of it. He is so knowledgeable about coffee and cooking that it makes the experience unforgettable. Make sure if you want the breakfast plate to arrive before 10am otherwise the lunch is just as fantastic (smoked salmon bagel, my fave!).

A perfect place to meet friends and relax in style. Everything from the chef, staff, food to coffee is phenomenal. On weekends, make sure to arrive before 10 if you want to try the amazing breakfast plate.

I recently visited Capian Coffee and had a fantastic experience. The breakfast was delicious, and the service was great. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the overall experience enjoyable. Highly recommend it for a great start to your day!

1901.aj: 〒299-5244 千葉県守谷 守谷海水浴場

rv.t: There was a gale warning when we came last Sunday(Sept14) but despite of the warning, Moriya beach did not disappoint me. The rock formations are soo beautiful. The parking lot is near the sea. There is a shower area nearby but they charge 500yen per person, the old lady in charge was so kind. We will come again ❤️

Beautiful beach! We went on mid of July weekend, even though wasn't crowded. The climate for swimming was perfect and the water was very clear. Had a great time with friends and family. 🤩 Still only 4 star because of the moss in the water here and there.

It’s a nice beach! It was not crowded at all. We went in mid June so the water was too cold to swim since it was a cloudy day. That said it was so nice for tidepooling and climbing on the rocks. Saw lots of cool critters! I think if it had been a hot day the water temp wouldn’t have mattered.

1902.a: Japan, 〒270-1453 Chiba, Kashiwa, Katayama, 275 RECAMP しょうなん（フォレストエリア/受付）
1902.aj: 〒270-1453 千葉県柏市片山２７５ RECAMP しょうなん（フォレストエリア/受付）
catj: アウトドア衣料・用品店
1902.ed: People say this campground offers well-maintained facilities, including clean restrooms, showers, and cooking areas, with many sites featuring amenities like hammocks and spot coolers. They also highlight the variety of activities for children, such as athletic equipment and a slide, and appreciate the helpful staff. Other reviews mention there can be disruptive stadium noise.
1902.edj: このキャンプ場を利用した人からは、清潔なトイレ、シャワー、炊事場など、手入れの行き届いた設備が提供されていると評判です。多くのサイトにはハンモックやスポットクーラーといった設備が備わっているようです。また、アスレチックや滑り台など、子ども向けの多様なアクティビティも充実しており、スタッフの対応も親切だと評価されています。 一方で、近くのスタジアムからの騒音が気になるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: It feels like it's in the mountains, but it's quite warm even in winter.

過去、家族5人のキャンプ予約をしました。 しかし子供がインフルエンザにかかってしまい急遽キャンセルすることになりました。 2か月後くらいに再度予約しましたが、ここでも子供の体調が悪くなりキャンセルすることになってしまいました。 残念なことは、いずれもキャンセル料100%だったことです。 1度目は仕方ないかと諦めましたが、家族5人分なので2度目はさすがにつらかったです。 このキャンセル料100%は多くの宿泊施設、キャンプ場運営においては仕方ないとは思いますが、以降予約するのが怖くなったのと、同じキャンプ場だっただけに、ただ寄付しているだけの感覚になり、RECAMPしょうなんさんにちょっと嫌気がさし、もう縁がないのだろうと行くのを諦めました。 他のキャンプ場予約もキャンセル料が設定されている場所はなるべく避けるようになりました。…

手賀の丘公園のじゃぶじゃぶ池には何度かお世話になったが、キャンプ場の利用は今回が初めて。 森エリアとレイクエリアに分かれており、最初は戸惑う。 受付さえ済ませてしまえば後はオートキャンプ、ないしセミオートキャンプでゆっくり設営するも良し、アスレチックで遊ぶも良し。 謎解きアトラクションもあり、それがなかなか難しくて楽しめた(大人でもクリアできない人は多いらしいので子供だけでは到底無理そう)。 レンタル品は必要最低限は揃ってる感じ。 シャワーやトイレもあるし割とキレイ。 売店は受付にだけありしかも早めにしまってしまうので買うものがあれば先に買ってから行くのが良さそう。 ひとつ難点があるとすれば、このキャンプ場は悪くないのだが、夜中の2時頃に近くで馬鹿な暴走族が大きなエンジン音を響かせており、眠りが浅い人は恐らく起こされてしまうであろう事。 それ以外はスタッフさんの対応も良いし、総じて良いキャンプ場と思いました。

1903.a: Ojinjo, 西牧ビル 1F 2 Chome-2-10 Ebisunishi, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0021, Japan
1903.aj: 〒150-0021 東京都渋谷区恵比寿西２丁目２−１０ 西牧ビル 1F 晩酌屋おじんじょ
1903.ed: Chill izakaya with an intimate vibe serving eclectic pub fare, from sashimi to roast chicken.
1903.edj: ゆったりとくつろげる隠れ家的な居酒屋。刺身や神明鶏の肉汁焼きなど、さまざまな居酒屋メニューを味わえる。

rv.t: This cozy bar is a hidden gem in Japan. Despite its small size and being frequently fully booked, it offers a delightful dining experience. The menu boasts delicious dishes and an extensive selection of drinks. The staff are exceptionally friendly, and their recommendations were spot on. We particularly enjoyed the Shimmei chicken, beef tendon with radish, potato salad topped with curry-flavored pickled radish…

No English menu. Staff doesn't speak english as well. But they did their best to cater to me. I had the omakase course. Good food and a lot of them. I think I was served a total of 7 dishes. Some of which are not the usual food you'll find in Tokyo.
Famous for liquor with Soda ,well I felt so-so. Food quality was nice, can enjoy nice Japanese izakaya style food. Cash & credit are available.

1904.a: Jindaiji Temple, 5 Chome-１５-1 Jindaiji Motomachi, Chofu, Tokyo 182-0017, Japan
1904.aj: 〒182-0017 東京都調布市深大寺元町５丁目１５−１ 深大寺
1904.ed: Buddhist temple, founded 733 & rebuilt 1919, with a 17th-century gate & annual soba noodle festival.
1904.edj: 733 年建立の仏教寺院。1919 年に再建。17 世紀に建てられた山門と毎年恒例のそば祭りが有名。

rv.t: We visited Jindaiji Temple for Hatsumode on a weekday, and were pleasantly surprised by how calm and uncrowded it felt. While many shrines and temples in Tokyo become overwhelmingly busy during the New Year period, Jindaiji offered a much more relaxed and local atmosphere. The temple grounds are decently sized and easy to explore, surrounded by greenery that makes it feel far removed from the city despite being in…

Lovely temple located in a quiet neighbourhood. There's a path you can walk which brings you to the Botanic Garden. The temple is not that big but there are many points of interests to check out, look at the map. Don't miss out on the dango and soba (their specialty which you don't wanna miss).
One of my fave places in Japan. Second time here. The soba is seriously good and everyone is so nice. Tons of keepsakes and the vibe is just so peaceful. Spread my ashes here when am gone

1905.aj: 〒404-0053 山梨県甲州市塩山小屋敷２２８０ 臨済宗 妙心寺派 乾徳山 恵林寺.
1905.ed: Serene Buddhist temple with a gravesite & picturesque grounds, including a pond & gardens.
1905.edj: 墓所のある落ち着いた寺院。池や庭園がある美しい境内が特徴。

rv.t: Absolute Must-Visit! Pay the 500 yen to go inside! ​Erin-ji is an incredibly beautiful, peaceful temple with an amazing atmosphere. It’s the perfect place to clear your mind and just relax. ​Pro Tip: Do not just look from the outside! Paying the 500 yen admission fee to go inside is 100% worth it. You get a rare and unique experience walking through the historic temple corridors, and the view of the traditional…
The garden and the temple are worth the stop. It was on my visiting list since I follow Takeda Shingen. I highly recommend if you are looking for peace !

Very quiet yet very beautify. We stopped here when leaving Yaminashi. It’s a must see. Only recommendation is out the address for the parking lot out front or Google Maps will take you on very scary back roads that were too small for our car.

1906.a: Kirishima Shrine, 2608-5 Kirishimataguchi, Kirishima, Kagoshima 899-4201, Japan
1906.aj: 〒899-4201 鹿児島県霧島市霧島田口２６０８−５ 霧島神宮
1906.ed: Shinto shrine set within dense forest, featuring lacquered columns & traditional architecture.
1906.edj: うっそうとした森の中にある神社。朱漆塗りの柱と伝統建築が特徴。

rv.t: Out final day in Kagoshima, we still had access to our rental car and wanted to go inland to some local attractions. Whilst we enjoyed the drive and scenery, and the surrounding walk. It's a bit too rural to recommend, the shrine itself is nice, but after weeks of visiting various shrines in Japan, it's nothing particularly different. I wouldn't recommend, unless you have nothing else to do.

A truly beautiful and peaceful shrine, especially in the late afternoon. The atmosphere here feels very different from city shrines – surrounded by nature, calm, and quietly powerful. Even though it was a bit cloudy when we arrived, the mood was still magical and made the visit feel very special. One detail I really appreciated was the natural hot spring water used at the washing area. Being able to cleanse your…
Beautiful surroundings. For goshuin collectors, the goshuin is 直書き. It was not very crowded when we went in mid-March. Not too sure about other timing.

1907.a: Japan, 〒101-0051 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kanda Jinbocho, 1 Chome−40−1 JLBグランエクリュ神保町 1階 餃子の肉太郎
1907.aj: 〒101-0051 東京都千代田区神田神保町１丁目40−１ JLBグランエクリュ神保町 1階 餃子の肉太郎
1907.ed: Diners like this restaurant's hearty, meat-filled gyoza with thick, chewy skins, and appreciate that larger orders are served in batches to ensure they are always hot. They also highlight the variety of unique dipping sauces, the delicious side dishes, and the option for a free rice refill. Guests mention the staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service, creating a welcoming…
1907.edj: このお店を利用した人は、厚くてもちもちした皮に肉がぎっしり詰まった、食べ応えのある餃子を高く評価しています。また、注文数が多い場合は、常に熱々の状態で提供されるよう、餃子が数回に分けて運ばれてくる点も好評です。ユニークなつけダレの種類が豊富なこと、美味しいサイドメニュー、そしてご飯のおかわりが無料であることも、多くの人が良い点として挙げています。スタッフは親切で気配りができており、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているため、居心地の良い雰囲気で食事ができるという声が多く聞かれます。

rv.t: These look kind of like regular gyoza, but they are not. Skin is perfect thickness and chewiness. They don't fall apart, and aren't filled with too much liquid. The filling is super delicious, definitely not commodity ground pork.
Super tasty gyoza with reasonable price and one sidedish as for free
Very good service 👍

1908.a: Udagawa Cafe, LD&Kビル 1/2F 18-4 Udagawacho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0042, Japan
1908.aj: 〒150-0042 東京都渋谷区宇田川町１８−４ LD&Kビル 1/2F 宇田川カフェ
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1908.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, desserts like cheesecake and gateau chocolat, and hearty meals such as ginger pork and keema curry, all within a cozy, dimly lit atmosphere with antique-style decor. Other reviews mention staff can be indifferent and food can be inconsistent.
1908.edj: モダンで洒落た大人の隠れ家のようなカフェ。穏やかな空間でイタリアンを中心とした洋食がカジュアルに頂ける。

rv.t: The place has immaculate vibes. It's a local's place for coffee and light fare. If you're new to this type of service, the wait staff won't bother you about your order until you flag them down. When all your items are delivered, you'll get the check on a little clipboard, and when you're done, take clipboard and payment to the counter. 10/10, magical place for super late night chill vibes.
Opens till 5 am very good for late night work study session!

The staff is very rude. They don’t like foreigners. To be clear, I know some Japanese and asked for a table politely and did not have large obnoxious bags for my party of 2. I didn’t shove my phone in peoples faces or speak loudly, in fact we barely spoke because of how uncomfortable we felt there. The staff rolled their eyes as soon as we walked in and just gestured sharply to the seating area and walked away. I…

1908.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1909.a: Song Kee Jee Fan, 2 Chome-15-1 Kanda Tsukasamachi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0048, Japan
1909.aj: 〒101-0048 東京都千代田区神田司町２丁目１５−１ 松記鶏飯
1909.ed: Down-to-earth restaurant presenting traditional Singaporean cooking, plus beer & wine.
1909.edj: 伝統的なシンガポール料理、ビールやワインを提供する落ち着いた雰囲気の店。

rv.t: The Bah Kut Teh is pretty close but still not quite close enough (They named the resto to Song Kee so expectations is raised). The soup can be richer and garlicker but it's enjoyable nonetheless. Best part in this place is it's the first Singaporean resto in Japan that have served a chili padi in my dark soy sauce. At long last a chili padi! The chicken rice is not bad too. I think they got the sauces right like…
Some of the most authentic Singaporean food you can find in Tokyo. Owner is passionate and vibes are great. Not expensive, a little walk from the station. Very memorable! Would come back.

You will not go wrong with the chicken rice. The chicken is so tender, juicy and delicious. For a moment I thought I was back in Singapore. The laksa is a little creamy but if you add some sambal chili into it, you will not be disappointed. I’m a Singaporean so I really love spicy food because it is part of our cuisine. I will be back to try out their other dishes. Awesome respect for the wonderful chef and staff!

1910.a: Japan, 〒319-0201 Ibaraki, Kasama, Kamigo, 1162 笠間 雪みるく
1910.aj: 〒319-0201 茨城県笠間市上郷１１６２ 笠間 雪みるく
1910.ed: People say this cafe offers a wide variety of delicious shaved ice desserts, featuring fresh seasonal fruits and generous portions. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the charming, traditional Japanese house atmosphere. Guests mention the clean restrooms and the convenient option to purchase fresh local vegetables and fruits.
1910.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮な旬のフルーツをふんだんに使った、種類豊富でおいしいかき氷が高く評価されています。かき氷はボリュームがあり、リーズナブルな価格も特徴のようです。また、趣のある古民家の雰囲気が良いという声もあります。お手洗いが清潔で、新鮮な地元の野菜や果物を購入できる点も好評です。

rv.t: 古民家カフェｯ♡ 普通の家みたいな感じのお店ｯ‼︎ 入るとフルーツや野菜が売っていて‥奥でかき氷ｯ♡ 季節によってパンケーキも食べられるｯ♡ 予約必見ｯ(*´-`) かき氷‥種類豊富で美味しいお店ｯ♡ 県外からも来てるの見た事あるーｯ^_^ メロンの上にのってるかき氷もあるよーｯ‼︎ かき氷‥ふわふわｯ♡ 注文ゎ、レジみたいになっていて画面で選ぶスタイルｯ^_^
古民家のかき氷屋さん🍧 LINE予約システム 入り口の直売所に旬の野菜や果物が安価で販売しています。 かき氷も価格帯も1000円前後で安価で季節の色々な味が楽しめます。 とうもろこし味🌽大好きです。 ドルチェドリームも箱買いします。 パンケーキもフルーツたっぷりで美味しいです🥞
昨年テレビで観て、やっと行って来ました。メロンの半玉がお皿でかき氷がのっててとても美味しいです。 もろこしみるく🌽は、私は特に好きです。 畑の中の古民家ですが、予約制なのでゆったり出来ます。入口には、スイカやメロン、桃など野菜類も売っていてお客さんが結構買って帰っていました。

1911.a: The Pizza Bar On 38th, 2 Chome-1-1 Nihonbashimuromachi, Chuo City, Tokyo 103-8328, Japan
1911.aj: 〒103-8328 東京都中央区日本橋室町２丁目１−１ ピッツァバー ON 38TH
1911.edj: イタリアンレストラン内に併設されたピッツァバー。オープンキッチンのカウンター席で、窯焼きピッツァとワインを提供する。

rv.t: If you are a pizza lover you should make sure to get a reservation at the pizza bar. All ingredients are fresh and sourced from Japan. The pizza dough is light and thanks to the omakase concept you get to try 6 different pizza - some classics and some seasonal. My favorite was the spinach crostino. The chefs prepare the pizza in front of you and explain each flavor. The atmosphere is light and friendly. All the…

When I first heard about this place, I balked at the price. ¥17,600? Per person ?? For pizza?!? I’m a New Yorker; I grew up with a slice costing $1.25! (It ended up costing ¥20,240 person after the 15% service charge was added.) But we had a gift certificate to the Mandarin Oriental, so we decided to use it here, and we did not regret it. The vast majority of the food was amazing (I didn’t like the seafood pizzas…

Slightly overrated if you ask me, especially given there’s apparently a 10k person waitlist… we put ourselves on the waitlist for a Friday during Cherry blossom season (2025) 1.5 weeks in advance and got the sitting. The pizza tastes good, the ingredients are clearly fresh and very high quality. Some of the flavor pairings worked really well, others not so much. It’s a fun experience but I think overall traditional…

1912.a: Hachi, 伊藤ハイツ 3 Chome-12-5 Okubo, Narashino, Chiba 275-0011, Japan
1912.aj: 〒275-0011 千葉県習志野市大久保３丁目１２−５ 伊藤ハイツ 食堂八

rv.t: Great atmosphere and food

平日の12時前の時間帯でランチ目的で入店しましたが（たまたまなのか）私１人でした。外観がすごく古めかしく最初は入るかためらいましたが店前メニュー看板を見て日替わり定食「タルタル牡蠣フライとカニクリームコロッケのダブル定食」という私の好物に魅かれかついまどき880円というリーズナブルな価格にも好印象を持ちまして入店を決意しました。学生の多い町ゆえの価格設定かなと思いましたがロープライス実現にはやはり理由があるような気もしました。まず量が普通よりも少なめかも…です。私みたいなおじさんはいいかもしれないけど大学生の男子なんかには足りないだろう。フライはどちらも「かなり」長い期間冷凍だったものをようやく解凍して調理したかの感じでした。サクサク感が全くなかったもので…噛んで出る牡蠣汁なんだけども磯の風味が今まで食べてきたモノとは（悪い意味で）異なるように感じて。ご飯サラダみそ汁は普通かな…キムチも少量ながら出ます。好物メニューの割には全然…
夜でも定食が食べれるお店🍚しかも安い。 単純に思ったのは男性、足りる？？だったけどご飯は有料で大盛りにできる🍚 色々な物価高でもこの金額で提供していただけるのは有り難いかと🙏 喫煙可なのでタバコ嫌いな人には向かない🚬 店員さんの愛想は良かったですよ🍚！

1913.a: Japan, 〒275-0011 Chiba, Narashino, Okubo, 1 Chome−19−18 Salon de thé La pluie
1913.aj: 〒275-0011 千葉県習志野市大久保１丁目１９−１８ Salon de thé La pluie

rv.t: 住宅街に溶け込んだカフェ。 中に入るとあたたかくそれでいて清涼な空間。 時間の流れがそこだけ違うような非日常感があり、その体験こそがカフェ・リトリート。 一杯のティザンヌ(ハーブティー)だけでも、味と香りの豊かさに充分リトリート気分が味わえるが せっかくならぜひ、コースも堪能してみて欲しい。 植物療法士である店主の手にかかるとアイスクリームも極上のフィトテラピーになる。 目、音、肌感(空気感)、香り、味 すべての五感が満たされ、本来の自分を取り戻せる。 そんな時間を過ごせる場所。
住宅街の中の静かなカフェ

1914.a: Japan, 〒311-4313 Ibaraki, Higashiibaraki District, Shirosato, Kamiirino, 4384 城里町総合野外活動センター ふれあいの里
1914.aj: 〒311-4313 茨城県東茨城郡城里町上入野４３８４ 城里町総合野外活動センター ふれあいの里

rv.t: Hureai No Sato is a nice camping area in Shirosato Town in Ibaraki prefecture. ||||When I went there, I found you can cook and eat the fish that you catch there at the campground. So, you can eat fresh fish in a place full of nature. Hureaino Sato also has white and black goats which are friendly and quiet. So, they are safe. You can enjoy feeding and petting them. Best of all, you can do BBQ there without any prior…
Site fee is cheap. Good facility. You can hike, fish and visit astronomical observatory in the site to see moon at night. Kids loved Goat.
easy to access, great place to watch stars.

1915.a: Oarai Isosaki Shrine, 6890 Isohamacho, Oarai, Higashiibaraki District, Ibaraki 311-1301, Japan
1915.aj: 〒311-1301 茨城県東茨城郡大洗町磯浜町６８９０ 大洗磯前神社
1915.ed: Revered 9th-century shrine set on the coastline with various prayer services, festivals & events.
1915.edj: 海沿いにある 9 世紀創建の神社。多くの崇敬を集めており、さまざまな祈祷、祭りや行事が行われている。

rv.t: It’s a place that’s definitely worth visiting. From the parking lot, it takes less than a minute to walk to the shrine. As soon as you arrive, you’ll see stairs leading down toward the opposite side where the famous Kamiiso no Torii is located. It’s not far—just right across—but on the way back, you’ll need to climb a fairly long flight of stairs. The spot is especially well-known for its beautiful sunsets.

Oarai Isosaki Shrine is a really beautiful place! ⛩️ I especially liked the torii gate standing right in the ocean. 🌊 The views were quite scenic and peaceful. It's definitely worth a visit to experience the unique coastal atmosphere. 😌📸
Love it. Was lucky that there was an event that day where we got to see pouding mochi and also got a free tasting.

1916.a: Amabikisan Rakuhōji (Amabiki Kannon), 1 Motogi, Sakuragawa, Ibaraki 309-1231, Japan
1916.aj: 〒309-1231 茨城県桜川市本木１ 雨引山 楽法寺
1916.ed: Visitors say this temple offers stunning seasonal flowers like Kawazu cherry blossoms and hydrangeas, along with free-roaming peacocks, goats, and ducks that create a unique, calming atmosphere. They also highlight the beautiful views of the Kanto Plain from the elevated grounds and the well-maintained, photo-friendly displays. Guests mention the ample free parking and the availability of special…
1916.edj: このお寺を訪れた人からは、河津桜や紫陽花など、季節ごとに美しい花々が楽しめると評判です。また、放し飼いのクジャク、ヤギ、アヒル、カモなどがいて、独特の穏やかな雰囲気を味わえるという声が多くあります。高台にある境内からは関東平野の素晴らしい景色が広がり、手入れの行き届いた、写真撮影にぴったりの場所がたくさんあると評価されています。無料の広い駐車場があり、期間限定の特別な御朱印も手に入ると好評です。

rv.t: I visited juat before Hydragea season on 28 May! Place was truly mythical with ducks, goats, roosters, peacocks. 2026 the year of the horse is an auspicious year for kannon and I received the blessings by entering the prayer hall for a fee of 1000yen. Seated in the hall, I could feel a sense of emptiness, my heart and mind was at peace! There were ample parking available too. I would love to come back here in the…

This spot is a true delight for nature enthusiasts like me! 🌿 Nestled in the mountains, it's surrounded by stunning natural beauty. You might even catch a glimpse of peacocks dancing during the rainy season. 🦚 A wonderful escape! ✨🏞️

I loved this place, I could have spend the whole day looking at the peacocks and enjoying the serenity and beauty of the place. Definitely on the top 3 best places to go in Japan. (If you love nature, animals, peacefulness, Japanese architecture, amazing views and a bit of quiet, you’ll love this place too). I couldn’t take more pictures because my phone died, but omg what a place!

If you haven't tried this Thai beauty, you're MISSING OUT! 10/10 would die for this again 🧡 #SomTam #RawPapayaSalad #FoodComa #SpicyLove

It wasn't authentic, but taste reached the mark. Here, somtham is made by mango, not papaya, and the taste was good. Please ask not to add more sugar if you wanna try real taste. But it takes good time, so be patient to stand in the line.
The papaya salad here is as good as any I've had in Thailand. I waited 45 minutes for mine and somehow didn't regret it.

rv.t: This place is an amazing find. The hype is definitely worth it especially because it is free. I would like to think if they cost for the entry then they would still have a lot of customers. The outside views are absolutely breathtaking and the inside shows history of our solar system and of anything space. If you come to LA this is an absolute must see. There is a lot of interactive activities for the kids to keep…

Always wanted to visit this place and it didn't disappoint. There were thousands of people there but not too crowded. The views of course was amazing my family had a great time just a slight uphill walk to the observatory wasnt bad good workout. Wife and I didn't well over 10k steps during this adventure. My boys loved it seeing new things they never seen before. There is no fee to go into the observatory but there…

This is easiest spot to take photo of the Hollywood sign and LA skyline. Park at the Greek theater and take the bus up. Only cost 50cents. It gets busy on the return bus. I was expectinf closer to the sign but guess save you from hiking up. The outside area is free. Plenty of spots to take photo.
